CLAUDE LINK  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  The claude command starts Claude Code through switchboard, so every session is routed.

  ✓  Link                 ~/.local/share/switchboard/bin/claude → switchboard

  !  Your shell           runs Claude Code's own claude, ~/.local/bin/claude, so its sessions aren't routed


  Add this line to your shell's startup file yourself, after anything else there that changes PATH:

      if [ -r "$HOME/.local/share/switchboard/shell/init.zsh" ]; then . "$HOME/.local/share/switchboard/shell/init.zsh"; fi  # switchboard

  Or, where you keep your PATH another way, put this directory first on it:

      $HOME/.local/share/switchboard/bin

  Then press r: setup asks your shell again, as a new terminal would start it.














c copy the line   d copy the directory   r check again                                                                           enter leave it for now   q quit
